scope: Independent read-only interpretation; no simulation or controller changes.
supported: The Environmental pressure-outlet plus slip-bed configuration completed1.2s with finite independent histories and bounded phase fraction. Two settings changed, so improvement cannot be attributed uniquely to the pressure option.

Final water velocity maximum18.4707m/s is compatible with the target current plus wave motion. Final global maximum23.9395m/s occurs in air0.5m from the outlet; four final cells exceed20m/s, all air. This is a substantial improvement over R3's50m/s reversed water flow but still needs trend/local-field checks.

Core gauge first-cycle fundamental amplitude differences are+0.480 to+1.168percent and phase differences−0.369 to−0.475degrees. The first cycle includes startup, so these are preliminary propagation diagnostics.

inventory_vs_budget.interpretation: Difference of total water inventory versus the undamped analytical wave across the whole domain, not a measured uniform rise or core mean-level error. Outlet damping intentionally changes the downstream wave field; startup redistribution and numerical error must be separated.
inventory_vs_budget.implication: Summed dt*BDF2 residual to the first period is~0.02877kg, equivalent~0.018mm over the1.6m2 horizontal area under constant phase densities. Its scale is far below the9.53mm reference-inventory difference. Do not describe that difference as a numerical conservation leak or assume increasing inner iterations will eliminate it.
inventory_vs_budget.qualification: Summed BDF2 residual is a discrete-budget diagnostic, not an independently measured physical water-level shift. Phase-specific budgets and zonal inventories improve interpretation.
inventory_vs_budget.analytic_inventory_discretization: The spatially sampled analytical volume oscillates with phase even over four wavelengths. Equal-phase comparisons reduce this quadrature/phase effect; instantaneous whole-domain comparisons alone are insufficient.
inventory_vs_budget.next_reports: Track actual, undamped-reference and flat-reference water inventories separately in inlet-forcing, protected-core and outlet-damping zones. Compare equal-phase values across complete cycles and report core gauge cycle means.

guard_and_probe.gate_interpretation: Existing campaign diagnostic criterion, not a universal CFD accuracy limit. Preserve it and investigate the exceedances; do not relax it to admit a longer run.
guard_and_probe.controlled_probe: The same saved0.500s state continued to0.750s at20inner versus original10inner, with unchanged mesh, SO1ms and boundary conditions, brackets all four spikes and is a sound local inner-convergence comparison.
comparison_requirements: Compare the identical0.500–0.750s interval, excluding only any explicitly documented restart-history initialization samples.
Compare signed/absolute integrated budget, peak residual, per-boundary flux, inventory, speed/phase bounds and core gauge differences; a smaller peak alone is insufficient.
The probe diagnoses inner sensitivity locally. It does not establish long-run propagation or a universally sufficient inner count.

wave_metrics.distinction: Fundamental-amplitude error and crest-to-trough wave-height error are different for a FifthOrder wave. The sampled height difference is+1.26 to+2.02percent, larger than the+0.48 to+1.17percent fundamental-amplitude difference. Report both.

longer_run_gates: Resolve the prescribed numerical-budget gate with matched evidence, and retain unchanged finite-value, phase-bound and50m/s guards.
Admit only a bounded continuation with checkpoints and zonal inventories; current1.2s is1.416periods, shorter than80m-domain phase transit~3.389s.
Require repeatable complete-cycle core height, fundamental phase, mean level and zonal inventory without secular drift; inspect outlet-air speed/pressure evolution.
Perform appropriate reflection/propagation assessment after enough transit time. A quiet central gauge or a boundary-zone analytical match alone cannot demonstrate low reflections.
Demonstrate wave-specific timestep and free-surface-grid sensitivity before final foil-force comparisons. Calm-mesh validation and this coarse no-foil mesh do not transfer automatically.
Once wave settings are supported, compare matched calm and wave cases using the same domain/grid/settings and average complete settled encounter cycles.
